verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents a Browser Profiler that creates persistent profiles with saved authentication states and cookies (crawl4ai-gh-3). It also supports session re-use and session management (crawl4ai-docs-6, crawl4ai-gh-18) and user-owned managed browsers (crawl4ai-gh-16), so authenticated pages can be fetched. However, the evidence never shows a developer passing their own cookies directly into a crawl or API request; it only shows reusing profile or session state. Missing for 10: an explicit, documented way to supply your own cookies per request (library or Docker API), and hands-on corroboration of authenticated crawling.
